Refuted at this gate: with a stale sidecar that cannot be deleted, SQLite's own delete fails on open and the store refuses to open (Echo fails closed, visibly; the dedup store is the existing observable fail-open); a corrupt verdict is not reachable from a zero-byte file, so there is no per-start quarantine and no kKeepQuarantined eviction (3, echo_db.cpp:75 and command_dedup_quarantine.hpp:38). The original main file is already hard-linked and its name dropped before the sidecar loop runs. Residual is the documented refusal (I5, E5, MEDIUM at most) and is pre-existing.
adjudicated_by: independent adjudication agent for this governance run (not the change author, not the agent that raised the finding); the de-escalation standard applies
adjudication_rationale: the HIGH rested on I2 through a replay that SQLite does not perform; the adjudicator ran two scratch experiments with the system SQLite (Python sqlite3 module) beside a zero-byte database and read the claim loop at sqlite_quarantine.hpp:201-246 against 388+; the residual keeps I5/E5
refuted_by: scratch experiment 1: a valid uncheckpointed -wal and -shm copied beside a 0-byte echo.db, then opened: integrity_check ok, sqlite_master empty, -wal deleted by SQLite, not replayed; scratch experiment 2: a hot -journal beside a 0-byte main file was deleted, integrity ok (system sqlite3 3.51.0, disposable directories); code read: echo_db.cpp:1000-1005 and 1069-1081 refuse the open and quarantine nothing, and the banner line 'SQLite deletes a WAL beside an empty database'

trigger: a descriptor copy fails after its exclusive create
classification_rationale: raised as a policy-floor candidate; the floor needs a named adjudicator who is not the proposer or the author
summary: Raised by the security review as a candidate for the manual-cleanup floor.

Not a policy floor. The floor text is aimed at acquire and release pairs of owned handles where an exit path can leak; the two descriptors here are owned by ScopedFile and closed before the removal, which is a single call with no early return or throwing step between the create and the removal, and whose result is reported in the note. An owner-style guard for the removal is expressible and is optional hardening, not a gate item. The documentation of the earlier adjudication bullet in the resource ledger should name this adjudicator and the removal at line 261.
adjudicated_by: cpp-safety reviewer, governance gate 3 round 2 (not the change author, not the security reviewer who proposed the candidate); the de-escalation standard applies
adjudication_rationale: read the whole function at the settled head: the only held resources are two ScopedFile descriptors; the removal runs after the inner block closes the destination; the 'documented impossibility' exception is deliberately not invoked because an owner-style guard is expressible
